base.description: The palette. One ramp per appearance, addressed by name rather than by context.

type.description: The type system. Roles, families and weights, identical in both appearances.

space.description: The grid and the radius. Fixed in pixels, identical in both appearances.

depth.description: The layer scale. One name per floating thing on screen, identical in both appearances.

motion.description: Durations and easings. Identical in both appearances.

icon.description: The icon size ladder. Two rungs for a glyph that stands alone, identical in both appearances.

state.description: The interaction state ladder. Values that are not a colour, identical in both appearances.

appearance.description: The two appearances the product ships.
